rationale: The proposed topology improves the S21 gain by adding a gate inductor to enhance input matching and resonant gain at 2.44 GHz, directly addressing the binding S21 failure while maintaining stability and low noise. The inductor tunes the input impedance to better match 50Ω, increasing forward gain without degrading NF or Idd. The addition of a single inductor is within the allowed budget and aligns with narrowband LNA best practices for gain peaking.
